description: This Java class 'ScriptUtil' provides utility methods for evaluating and executing scripts using various scripting engines (like Groovy, JavaScript, etc.) via the JSR-223 API within the OFBiz framework. It manages script compilation, security checks, context creation, and script execution, including support for compiled scripts, security restrictions, and scripting engine discovery.

classes.name: ScriptUtil.ProtectedBindings
classes.description: A custom implementation of the Bindings interface that enforces read-only protections for specified keys during script execution.

methods.name: compileScriptFile
methods.description: Loads and compiles a script file into a CompiledScript using the appropriate scripting engine based on file extension.

methods.name: compileScriptString
methods.description: Compiles a script string based on its language into a Cached CompiledScript for efficient re-use.

methods.name: createScriptContext
methods.description: Creates a ScriptContext populated with a given variable map, including helper objects and context binding.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a script string in a specified language with a given script class and context, returning the result.

methods.name: executeScript
methods.description: Executes a precompiled script and optionally invokes a specific function within it, returning the result.

methods.name: executeScript
methods.description: Loads and executes a script from a file at a given location, optionally invoking a specific function.

methods.name: executeScript
methods.description: Executes a script specified by its file path with optional function invocation and context, handling various scripting engines.

methods.name: parseScript
methods.description: Analyzes and parses a script string into a Java class if supported (e.g., Groovy).

methods.name: checkIfScriptIsSafe
methods.description: Performs security checks to determine whether executing a given script content is permitted based on hashes and security tokens.
